title: Ancient North Arabian languages
displaytitle: Ancient North Arabian languages

titles.display: Ancient North Arabian languages

extract: Ancient North Arabian languages are a hypothetical family of ancient Semitic languages represented in the Ancient North Arabian scripts. Among the languages of pre-Islamic Arabia, they are closely related to Old Arabic, although distinct from it.
